semantics.state: intended directorial state, not measured visual quality or audience emotion
semantics.values: 0..1 relative director controls; energy is intended motion intensity, not audio RMS
semantics.warmth: perceptual emotional light and reflected warmth, not a full-frame orange filter
semantics.openness: space available to move into and breathe; does not require removing every foreground
semantics.wind: coherent subtle organic movement, not random jitter or a particle count
semantics.glitchAllowance: budget multiplier for optional space and graphic disruptions; existing short black punctuation keeps authored timing
semantics.interpolation: controls use absolute music time and linear interpolation between adjacent keyframes; section and shot labels remain categorical
semantics.source: Latest user emotional direction; existing shot boundaries and authored lyric timings. No automatic emotion inference from RMS.
semantics.verification: Intent metadata does not confirm the rendered film satisfies this direction.
